links.comparator_used: The algorithm developed in an adult inpatient setting at one London trust, applied as-is to other organizations without trust-specific coding templates
links.outcome: Accuracy of theme and sentiment prediction in FFT free-text comments
links.effect: Accuracy was lower initially in pediatrics and mental health settings and 'significantly improved' with trust-specific coding templates; overall accuracy was >75%. No specific post-adaptation figures were given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Required manual coding of a subset of comments and iterative retraining at each trust; thematic saturation was reached after the fifth organization, so no further coding was needed for the last 4.
links.quote: However, the accuracy of our algorithm significantly improved when individual trust coding templates were applied.

design_hint: local recalibration with trust-specific coding templates before deployment
